function.name: get_product_data_health
function.description: Catalog health counts, including products_with_supplier, products_without_supplier, products_with_non_zero_supplier_price and products_with_zero_supplier_price. (GET /api/product-data-health/metrics)

function.name: list_products
function.description: Bulk-read the catalog. Rows include sku, name, type, archived_at, unit_cost, default_supplier_id, default_supplier_name, default_supplier_sku and default_supplier_price. filter[supplier_price.is_empty]=1 narrows to products whose default supplier link has no price (or that have no default supplier at all). (GET /api/v2/products)

filter[type].description: Comma-separated types. The roadmap counts standard,kit,manufactured,blemished.

filter[supplier_price.is_empty].description: Send 1 to keep only products with no default supplier price.

filter[default_supplier_id].description: Comma-separated supplier ids — products whose default supplier is one of them.

filter[search].description: Free-text search across SKU, name, barcode, MPN and brand.

per_page.description: Page size (default 10). Iterate page until last_page.

function.name: get_product_suppliers
function.description: A product's supplier links, each with supplier_sku, is_default and its pricing tiers (tier name and price). This is where the account's real tier name comes from, and it shows prices on non-default suppliers that the list filter can't see. (GET /api/products/{productId}/suppliers)

function.name: find_supplier
function.description: Resolve a supplier named on a price list to its supplier id. (GET /api/v2/suppliers)

search.description: Free-text search over supplier name, company and email.

function.name: get_last_purchase_price
function.description: The most recent non-draft purchase order line for the product with a price above zero: { amount, purchase_order_id, purchase_order_date }, or data null when it was never bought. (GET /api/products/{product}/last-purchase-price)

function.name: get_purchase_order
function.description: Read the purchase order behind a last purchase price, to learn which supplier it was bought from and in what currency before proposing it as that supplier's cost. (GET /api/purchase-orders/{purchase_order})

function.name: set_supplier_price
function.description: Write a supplier cost onto one product. Send only suppliers[], with operation "updateOrCreate" on every entry so no other supplier link is touched. Creates the supplier link when the product has none for that supplier. (PUT /api/products/{id})

suppliers.description: Each { supplier_id, operation: "updateOrCreate", pricing: [{ supplier_pricing_tier_name, price }], supplier_sku (optional), is_default (optional, only for a product with no default supplier) }. price is numeric, >= 0 and < 100000. An unknown tier name CREATES a new tier, so use a name read from get-product-suppliers.
